title: Each type during entry-test prep
caption:
Entry test prep, as experienced by all 16 types.

Some have a 90-day plan and are on schedule. Some have twelve 'final' timetables. Some started three weeks before the test and still passed, which is deeply unfair to everyone else.

To everyone preparing right now: you've got this. Tag your study partner for moral support.

Which type is your study style?
